gaps.sentence: The manuscript might ___ if you keep touching it with bare hands.
gaps.explanation: Get + past participle (get damaged) is an informal passive common with mishaps.

gaps.sentence: Several issues remain ___ (resolve) before the launch.
gaps.explanation: 'Remain' + passive infinitive (to be resolved) expresses unfinished business.
'By + future time' signals future perfect passive: will have been + processed.

gaps.sentence: The bridge ___ by a locally trained architect.
gaps.explanation: 'Was designed by' — passive with the agent in a by-phrase.

gaps.sentence: The recipe ___ (pass down) from generation to generation.
gaps.hint: continuing relevance from past to now
gaps.explanation: Present perfect passive: has been + passed down; the process links past and present.

gaps.sentence: Every complaint ___ (investigate) since the new ombudsman took over.
gaps.explanation: 'Every complaint' is singular, so present perfect passive: has been + investigated.

gaps.sentence: She couldn't pay because her wallet ___ (steal) at the market.
gaps.hint: earlier past action causing a past problem
gaps.explanation: The theft happened before the failed payment: past perfect passive, had been + stolen.

gaps.sentence: Nothing ___ about the leak until the inspector came.
gaps.explanation: 'Nothing was said' — the passive of 'nobody said'.
